versions.label: Original settings · 10 topics
versions.description: 211,425 training pages; 498 selected pages and page–topic links. No stopwords, 10 requested/retained topics, up to 50 top documents per topic. Relative weights within each topic, not probabilities or full-corpus prevalence.

versions.label: Swedish exploration · 39 retained topics
versions.description: 50 requested/39 retained topics; 5,765 page–topic links covering 5,764 selected pages from 211,425 training pages. 108 stopwords; up to 150 top documents/topic. Exploratory, not validated optimal. Relative weights within topics.
